description: Capability for the main window. Minimal: only `core:default`. The prototype declares no plugin permissions — no fs, no shell, no dialog, no opener, no http — because every command is read-only and exercised only through `invoke()` on app-defined Rust handlers. D3 long-job wire (2026-10-04 block): the `agenthd-operation` event is delivered through the built-in `core:default` permission; no extra plugin permission is required.
